blocks.text: Samsung Chromebook Plus V2 2-in-1 12.2" WUXGA LED Touchscreen Laptop

items: 【12.2" WUXGA Touchscreen LED Display】Embark on a visual journey where vibrant colors and high resolution come to life at your fingertips. 【2-in-1 Design 】Convert to a tablet with the flip of a screen around a 360° hinge.

【Intel Celeron Processor 3965Y】The low voltage design optimizes energy usage, allowing you to stay productive and entertained with great efficiency. Seamlessly multitask between study materials, stream your favorite entertainment content, and browse the internet smoothly without any lag. Experience Intel performance with entertainment features and fast connectivity.

【4GB LPDDR3 RAM】Plenty of high bandwidth to run multiple programs simultaneously without any slowdowns. 【64GB eMMC】Massive storage space for your files, applications, and multimedia content, providing fast and reliable data access.

【Island-type Keyboard】The shape of Island-type keyboard — square with rounded corners — offers a high level of ergonomics that's naturally comfortable to use, making it a popular choice among people who type a lot.【Intel HD Graphics 615】Enjoy solid image quality that brings your everyday content to life with vibrant colors and sharp details.

【Chrome OS】Using Chrome OS let you connect effortlessly with colleagues in the cloud and easily access calendars, documents and other business data.【Dimensions & Weight】11.35" x 8.2" x 0.7", 2.98 Lb. 【Ports and Accessories】1x USB 3.0, 2x USB-C, MicroSD Multi-media Card Reader, 1x Headphone out/Mic-in Combo, Internal Digital Dual Array Mic + Mono Mic, Built-in pen, 802.11 ac (2x2), Bluetooth 4.0, Samsung Bluetooth Mouse, 32GB Hotface USB Card.
